description:
Owner's law (2026-07-02): follow_up is an anti-northstar SMELL. Work runs for exactly two reasons: a consumer WAITS on a named fact/product (pull), or a CHANGED REVISION wakes a recorded reader. Owner's sharpening: "if a push-based / pass-based idea is being smuggled back in under a different name, that's a violation of the spirit of the pull/demand based approach. period."

DOC ALIGNMENT: the blanket rule is pull-based.html's Non-negotiable; northstar.html still tolerates follow_up for legacy jobs -- this arc retires that tolerance (update northstar.html's clause at arc close).

FAMILY 1 — DONE (e561842ce): seed_root's LowerFunction/PlanEntryDispatch pushes, proven always-coalesced, deleted.
FAMILY 2 — DONE (1ab96d652): seed_activation's AnalyzeActivation push proven redundant, deleted; seed_root's twin named family 3's gap.
FAMILY 3 — DONE (d8fa56ed1): scheduler demands-on-stall via the unified fact->producer map (World::demand_fact_producer, ~130 duplicate lines deleted); every submitted root is a standing demand for its entry analysis; seed_root's last push deleted; 19 push-dependent tests pass unmodified.
FAMILY 4 — DONE (folded 2026-07-02, three-lane audited PASS/PASS/PASS): body.rs's two real emission sites (TypeDefined/DeriveTypeDef in lower_function; GuardDispatch/ReifyGuardDispatch in collect_local_guard_requirements) converted to bare waits; the ~70-ref follow_up parameter threading through the three collectors deleted (Job import gone from body.rs); two new map arms (TypeDefined(t)->DeriveTypeDef(t), GuardDispatch(f)->ReifyGuardDispatch(f), grep-verified single-producer). MECHANISM EXTENSION (pull-shaped, audited no-deadlock): next_ready_job now expands ALL blocked waiters' facts on drain (World::demand_blocked_wait_producers) -- one dependency frontier per drain, strict progress, genuine stalls report Unresolved; demand_producer_if_needed skips paused-on-waits producers (wake-reachable, their missing facts are blocked waits the same expansion reaches).

THE TEMPORARY PUMP (in-code comment at drive.rs demand_producer_if_needed names this): a producer that ran, concluded, and did NOT claim the fact stays re-demandable, because the unconverted semantic layer's AnalyzeActivation concludes with zero outputs/waits and relies on re-demand. MEASURED COST: 0 re-demands on healthy fixtures; 37/compile (~3% of AnalyzeActivation runs) on enum_take_drop_split; no inflation vs parent (distributions overlap). REMOVAL CONDITION: the jobs/semantic.rs family converts conclude-by-omission to explicit claims, then tighten the skip to concluded producers outright. TARGET NUMBER for that family: the 37.

KNOWN FAIL-SLOW (pre-existing shape, audit-named, non-blocking): the product fact-wait loops have no stall_demanded-style per-fact suppression memo (the bare drive has one from family 3) -- a genuinely stuck fixture re-demands byte-identically until the 50k job budget errors out, paying 50k wasted runs before reporting. Terminates deterministically; fix opportunistically when a family touches those loops (or when fz-go4.19 dedups them into one implementation -- natural home).

FAMILY 5+ (remaining; the recipe is now uniform -- bare waits + map arms, one commit per family, static wait-graph proof primary): jobs/semantic.rs (~66 refs, incl. the conclude-by-omission AnalyzeActivation pump target and the DefineModule(protocol) watch item at semantic.rs:1255-1258), jobs/dispatch.rs (:130/:142 DeriveTypeDef/ReifyGuardDispatch pushes -- arms already exist, likely mechanical), jobs/contract.rs (:54, same), jobs/types.rs (:34-40), jobs/keying.rs, jobs/source.rs, source_publish.rs (2), quoted_expander.rs (4), world.rs (4, incl. wait_for_function_definition's DefineFunction push and require_activation_key_facts' gated pushes which seed_root forwards on early-return paths). Product-side jobs emit ZERO follow_ups.

TELEMETRY GAP: add an aggregate follow-up-emission counter (or extend session-finished) before declaring the final family complete (pull-based.html's follow_ups=0 proof).

WATCH ITEMS: (1) semantic.rs:1255-1258 DefineModule(protocol) producer relationship; (2) coalesced-telemetry conflation (scheduler.rs) -- split observability at arc close; (3) Scheduler::blocked/has_run pub-visibility sweep at arc close (pre-existing style, mild surface creep).

DONE = rg shows zero production follow_up emissions; JobEffects::follow_up field deleted; the .18.19 coalesce screen deleted; the temporary pump tightened; scheduler wake paths = changed-revision only plus the submit_root ignition; docs updated (fact-engine.md 'legacy jobs may enqueue follow-ups' dropped; northstar.html tolerance clause updated). Sequencing: fz-go4.18.31 AFTER the semantic.rs family.

comments.text: STARTING INVENTORY from the .18.19 removable-code audit (2026-07-02, at 424b2ae6a): (1) FIRST REMOVAL, proof complete: seed_root's LowerFunction + PlanEntryDispatch follow_ups (root.rs:75-76) are provably ALWAYS-COALESCED — the concluding branch requires Recursive+DispatchMask facts, whose producers (keying.rs:148-152 -> body.rs:287; keying.rs:84-90 -> dispatch.rs:169) must therefore have concluded; first-run demand already lives in DeriveRecursive/DeriveDispatchMask; change waves handle re-runs. Safe to delete as this arc's first family (own commit). (2) KEEP-classified: root.rs:77/:112 AnalyzeActivation (genuine first-run demand for a just-minted activation); ALL other emissions are absence-gated wait+demand pairs (semantic.rs:219/1257/1301/1492/1647/2265, dispatch, body, keying, source, world.rs:2094/2102, quoted_expander, source_publish) — these are the wait-implies-demand conversion targets. (3) Product-side jobs (artifact/runtime_demand/transport/backend/native) emit ZERO follow_ups already. (4) Minor: the coalesced telemetry channel conflates agenda-dedupe (scheduler.rs:257) with standing-conclusion suppression (scheduler.rs:228-232) — split the observability when this arc lands. (5) Watch item from the cross-lane note: semantic.rs:1255-1258 demands DefineModule(protocol) while waiting on ProtocolDispatch — the one site where a follow_up forced a concluded job's re-run as a wait-unblocking mechanism; resolve its real producer relationship during migration.

title: Migrate the semantic layer off follow_up: work runs only via waits (pull) or changed-revision wakes
